name: Mip-Splatting Training Loop & Evaluation Pipeline
definition: The complete training iteration and evaluation procedure for Mip-Splatting, handling camera sampling, subpixel-aware rendering, hybrid loss computation, adaptive densification/pruning, and quantitative metric reporting.
summary: The Mip-Splatting Training Loop and Evaluation Pipeline extends 3D Gaussian Splatting by incorporating subpixel-aware rendering to mitigate aliasing artifacts, distinguishing itself through explicit subpixel offset management and fixed-schedule adjustments to spherical harmonics and learning rates.
